sources.title: Colossus — original US plant patent
sources.enumerated_scope: Focal denomination, printed code and claim in one original grant. Parent and comparison names are accounted separately; not a company portfolio or a current rights assessment.
sources.limitations: Colossus is the focal denomination; the description also uses FL11-35. Claim 1 is on PDF page 3, printed column 6. Figure 2 on PDF page 5 shows fruit clusters; Figure 3 on page 6 shows harvested berries. Names and dates are original document metadata, not new alias, role, trait, growing-region, current-rights or image-reuse decisions. The printed applicant/assignee remains a historical source association. Google legal-status estimates were not used. Photographer and illustration reuse permission are not established.
